title: Lenses and narrowings
routing: Is this about what a lens is and what a narrowing lets a rule, filter or render see — LensNarrowing layers (picks / omits / enumPicks / enumOmits, relations turned on, root.where vs root.relations.<rel>.where vs mapDefaults model wheres), composition and clamps (layers only narrow, clampLens, validateNarrowing, LensRefusal, narrowRule's filter-first injection under all, storeLens / composeLens, projectLens surfaces) — or about the template's lenses: lensFor, a route's filterLens, scopeNarrowing, lensWhere, redactLens, omitForeignKeys, lensFromOperation, the email lens (emailLensFor / emailLensAt, scopeEmailLens, senderLensOwner, targetedBySender, narrowVariables / prune) and customerRefLens, or the no-lens-spread CI rule?
